decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the building hereby permitted shall be in accordance with those specified in the email submitted, dated 30 November 2008, as follows: -	Brick walls of Olde Cheshire Red Multi Brick-	Roof materials of fibre cement slates

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The use of the garage is restricted to residential parking and storage uses. The garage shall not be used for any form of residential accommodation or any commercial activity.
description: Demolition of the existing garages and erection of a new garage to the rear of no. 5 Ellesmere Road for use ancillary to No. 5.
